title: vending machine
description: A small mod to add a simple vending machine to Minecraft 1.21.1.
body:
A simple mod to add a vending machine to the game. Players can buy items from the machine. Allows the person that places the machine to set trades, add inventory, and collect their earnings. 

If no price is set the item is given away for free.

Shift+Right-click to open the setup screen. 
Right-click to interact.
